verdict.rationale: telli's docs describe Charlie, a built-in AI assistant that can build and refine agents, automate workflows, and analyze calls, so users can delegate core platform tasks to it. The MCP server docs, which let external AI tools talk to Charlie, corroborate that it is a real assistant that takes on tasks. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what Charlie can actually do (scope of actions, approval and review flow, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.
